text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Is this... a knee sleeve? For me?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm hoping it's all in my head, but... I've
noticed
your knee seems to be giving
you trouble lately.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I use these myself. The doctor I've been
seeing for
years recommended them to
me.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If you don't think it'll be any help, you
can just
give it back.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no, I... I'll use it. Thank you very
much.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One night, I spot Daiichi Ruby with a
vaguely
distressed look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her expression is so grave, I can't help
but say
something.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her expression is so grave, I can't help
but say
something.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your kind suggestion. I
shall do just
tha—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wahey-heyyyy! What's up, Rubae?! How
you
feeling, girl? Heckin' good or
heckin' nah? Whoa,
you're seriously not
looking so hot!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I'm quite all right, thank you. Now, if
you'll excuse
me...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wahey-heyyyy! What's up, Rubae?! How
you
feeling, girl? Heckin' good or
heckin' nah? Whoa,
you're seriously not
looking so hot!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
No biggie, though! This is nothing a little
sip of
boba can't cure! And look, I
literally just bought
some! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
What?! Are you seriously saying noba to
my
boba?! Wait up, bae! Don't run off so
fast! You're
gonna make your leg worse!
